# Pi - Muse Connector

This API puts **Pi agent** — the terminal coding agent ([GitHub: earendil-works/pi](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi), https://pi.dev) — behind a
plain REST interface so an AI agent like Meta Muse can ask it to do coding work.

## Bring your own key

Every task needs YOUR AI provider API key (e.g. an OpenRouter key). Send it as
the `X-Pi-Api-Key` header (or the `api_key` body field). The server uses it for
that one Pi run only: it is written into a job-local Pi config inside the
task's sandbox directory and deleted with it when the job ends. It is never
stored, never logged, and never sent anywhere except your provider's API.
You pay your provider directly; the connector operator sees and spends nothing.

Optional headers: `X-Pi-Provider` (default openrouter), `X-Pi-Model`
(default openrouter/free), `X-Pi-Base-Url` (needed only for providers the
server doesn't know; built in: openrouter, nvidia).

## How to use it

1. `POST /api/pi-task` with header `X-Pi-Api-Key: <your key>` and body
   `{ "task": "your coding task in plain words" }`.
   You get back `{ "job_id": "...", "status": "queued" }` immediately (HTTP 202).
2. `GET /api/pi-task/{job_id}` to poll. `status` moves through
   `queued` → `running` → `done` (or `failed` / `timeout`).
3. When `done`, `result` contains Pi's answer — usually code, an explanation,
   or both.

## What to ask for

Good tasks are specific and self-contained:

- "Write a Python script that reads sales.csv and prints revenue per month"
- "Fix the off-by-one bug in this function: <paste code>"
- "Explain what this regex does: <paste regex>"
- "Scaffold a Node Express app with one GET /health endpoint"

Each task runs in a fresh sandbox directory with a 5-minute hard timeout.
Tasks are processed one at a time and rate-limited per caller, so keep tasks
focused — one job per task, not a whole project.

## Limits

- Task text max 2000 characters; results truncated at ~50k characters.
- The sandbox is a temp dir with a scrubbed environment — assume no
  persistent filesystem.
- A missing key returns 401; unknown providers need `X-Pi-Base-Url`.

## Reference

- Full schema: `GET /openapi.json`
- Liveness: `GET /health`
